Susceptible individuals receive a vaccine and move to a separate vaccinated compartment.
Susceptible individuals become infected but do not show symptoms.
Infectious individuals recover from cholera and become immune.
Infectious individuals shed bacteria, which contaminates the water supply.

Name: β
Description: Rate of 'contact' with reservoir water.

Name: 1/γ
Description: Duration of cholera infection.

Name: γ
Description: The per capita recovery rate from cholera infection.

Name: 1/δ
Description: Cholera life span in water reservoir.

Name: δ
Description: The removal or decay rate of cholera bacteria from the water reservoir.

Name: ξ
Description: Rate of water contamination by humans, i.e., the rate of increase in V. cholerae concentration in the water reservoir.

Name: κ
Description: The concentration of V. cholerae that yields a 50% chance of infection.
